name: 5-in-1 Hair Colour Shampoo Brown – Natural Ammonia-Free Hair Dye for Hair, Beard, Moustache & Body Hair (180ml)
description:
Transform your look in minutes with this 5-in-1 Hair Colour Shampoo in a rich brown shade. Specially formulated to cover grey hair naturally, this versatile hair dye is perfect for coloring your hair, beard, moustache, chest, and other body hair, all with one easy application.
Made with a natural, ammonia-free formula, it gently deposits color while nourishing and conditioning your strands. The shampoo-based design ensures a mess-free experience — simply apply, lather, and rinse for a vibrant and even result.
Ideal for anyone looking for quick and long-lasting grey coverage, this hair color shampoo delivers a deep brown tone that blends seamlessly with your natural hair. The formula is suitable for all hair types and textures, leaving hair soft, shiny, and healthy-looking.

5-in-1 formula colors hair, beard, moustache, chest, and body hair

 	
Natural-looking brown shade with long-lasting grey coverage

 	
Ammonia-free and gentle on scalp and hair

 	
Shampoo-based application for quick and easy use

 	
Conditions and strengthens hair while coloring

 	
Suitable for men and women
